stem: Why is fixture electrical wattage alone insufficient for deciding how much photosynthetic light reaches a canopy?
choices: Wattage already measures PPFD at every canopy point
Wattage automatically includes photoperiod and DLI
All fixtures with the same wattage have identical spectra and photon distribution
Electrical input does not by itself specify photon output, fixture efficiency, distance, optics, or spatial distribution at the canopy
rationale: Electrical power is an input characteristic. Canopy photon exposure depends on fixture photon output and efficiency, geometry, distance, spectrum, and distribution.
